parameters.content:
## 02 SEO Article Automation
**Top lane = orchestrator** (triggers, preflight, queue). Each valid keyword is processed in its own **sub-execution of this same workflow** (via *When Called By Orchestrator*) so state, loops and failures stay isolated per keyword.

Before activation: set IDs in **Workflow Configuration**, attach credentials, run the Manual Test Trigger with one test row. Keep inactive until tests pass.

### Approval gates
Nothing reaches the master Google Doc unless the **same attempt** passed: structured-output validation → editorial evaluation (all checks PASS, no unsupported claims, deterministic checks) → a **new** plagiarism scan of that exact text (≤ threshold). Every failure is revised and fully re-checked, at most **MAX_ARTICLE_ATTEMPTS** times, then REVIEW_REQUIRED.
